text.p: These are the leading stories in Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov told the Parliament that the increasing demands for an ethnic Albanian university and for federalisation could lead to inter-ethnic conflict.
- Macedonian MPs launched discussion on 1997 state budget. Under the draft budget, inflation will be 2 percent and GDP increased by 5% in the next year.

- Macedonian opposition will be forced to make a coalition with other parties after the local elections; the Macedonian extremists' radical demands are weaker, says Washington democratic institute monitoring mission.
